notes: erase_text=true visibly cleans the surrounding court — the underlying MELBOURNE letters that bled through faintly in P3-A5 are gone; the surface around the Red Bull mark reads as a uniform painted blue. Trade-off: the inpainted area is now slightly smoother / more uniform than the matte-paint texture of the surrounding court paint, so texture_match drops to 3 (the inpaint hasn't reproduced the natural micro-grain of the court surface) and painted_on_vs_pasted_on slips to 3 because the patch reads as a slightly cleaner-than-court rectangle on close inspection. No halo, no edge reflex, no jitter. This is exactly where the metric regression (floor SSIM 0.975 -> 0.899) is coming from: the metric is comparing to the textured original-with-MELBOURNE while the visual is improved.
